message.content:
**Answer**

In European ancestry populations, the minor allele (C) at SNP **rs7412**—which defines the APOE ε2 allele—is present at roughly **7–8 %** frequency.  
For example, the gnomAD v2.1.1 dataset reports an allele frequency of **0.076** (≈ 7.6 %) in the “non‑Finnish European” (NFE) cohort【gnomAD】.  

This value represents an average over many European subgroups; specific frequencies can differ slightly among distinct continental or regional groups (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europe).

---

### References

| Source | Link |
|--------|------|
| gnomAD v2.1.1 – rs7412 allele frequency (Non‑Finnish European) | https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412 |
| ClinVar entry for rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) | https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/variation/1049/ |

*(Note: Frequencies are taken from publicly available genomic databases and reflect aggregated sample estimates.)*
